output.summary: Turnover rose well above the in-state peer median (+19 points vs +5), so market conditions alone do not explain it, and the HRIS migration is not the cause: separations match payroll and the rise began in Oct-Nov 2025, before the migration. The step-ups in March (Saturday policy, announced ShiftWise) and April predate any branch-level evidence, and no branch or manager breakdown or pay benchmark exists. Pay, manager and ShiftWise hypotheses remain unestablished. The manager-of-record field is stale, so A2 would punish the wrong people. Get the branch and ShiftWise comparison and a pay benchmark before committing to the pay increase or manager accountability.
